L15.claim: Education: Eidgenössische Polytechnische Schule (1911), Ph.D in Physics from University of Zurich (1906)
evidence: ETH
In July 1900 he completed his studies at the Polytechnic Institute with a
BRI
in 1911, following expansion in 1909 to full university status, it was renamed the Eidgenössische Technische Hochschule
AIP
the degree was formally awarded January 15, 1906
L15.note: The Zurich Ph.D. (1906) is confirmed. The Polytechnic date is wrong: Einstein finished his diploma in July 1900. 1911 is the year the school was renamed, not a year Einstein studied there. Note: NobelPrize.org says 1901 for the diploma (“In 1901, the year he gained his diploma”); ETH’s own library says July 1900. Also, the Ph.D. was in physics in substance, but the faculty that awarded it was Zurich’s Philosophy II faculty.

## Scoped evidence and proposed correction — approval required

**CONFIRMED (doctorate year only):** UZH says “His doctorate and corresponding certificate were conferred in January 1906.” Row L15 now reconciles the full education entry with exact spans.

**CORRECTION SUGGESTED:** IHH Princeton immigration 1932 → 1933. IAS describes its October 2, 1933 opening and says Einstein and Weyl “were in Europe and would arrive later in the month.” ([IAS](https://www.ias.edu/ideas/2008/batterson-opening-day), opening-day account). This supports Princeton arrival in October 1933, not every earlier US visit. No profile text changed.
